caption: Methodist Church Drama Group
history:
In December 1965 the Thurmaston Methodist Church Drama Group performed ‘Contrast’, three one act plays. Pictured above is a scene from ‘The Wedding Breakfast’. The programme (also included ‘Green for Danger’ and ‘The Soldier and the Woman’.
Back row: Ann Law, John Stretton, Mable Branson, Audrey Curtis, Jennifer Blount, Jim Needham, Mike Pochin, Eileen Ball. Sitting Eileen Lord, Hilary Billings.
